description: This file defines a mock class for MotionDetection implementation, used for testing purposes. It includes mock methods for various motion detection functionalities and sets default behaviors for platform init and termination functions.

classes.name: MotionDetectionImplMock
classes.description: A mock class inheriting from MotionDetectionImpl to facilitate unit testing of motion detection features.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_Platform_Init
methods.description: Mocks the platform initialization process, returning success by default.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_Platform_Term
methods.description: Mocks the platform termination process, returning success by default.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_RegisterEventCallback
methods.description: Mocks registration of motion event callback.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetMotionDetectors
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of current motion detectors.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_ArmMotionDetector
methods.description: Mocks arming of a motion detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_DisarmMotionDetector
methods.description: Mocks disarming of a motion detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_IsMotionDetectorArmed
methods.description: Mocks checking whether a motion detector is armed.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_SetSensitivity
methods.description: Mocks setting the sensitivity of a motion detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetSensitivity
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the sensitivity of a motion detector.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_SetActivePeriod
methods.description: Mocks setting the active period for motion detection.

methods.name: MOTION_DETECTION_GetActivePeriod
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the active period for motion detection.
